北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾气浓重，体感-3℃，出行请注意安全和保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is very foggy and feels like -3°C. Please stay safe and warm outdoors!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，体感6℃，出门享受冬日暖阳吧！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and feels like 6°C. Enjoy the winter sunshine!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗舒适，体感7℃，天气不错，出门散散心吧！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is clear and pleasant, feels like 7°C. Nice weather, enjoy a stroll!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光明媚，体感12℃，虽暖但也别忘了添衣哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and feels like 12°C. It's warm, but remember to dress appropriately.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感15℃，体感舒适，祝你有个愉快的一天！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and feels like 15°C. Pleasant weather, wishing you a great day!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阳光明媚，体感6℃，记得保暖，别着凉了。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and feels like 6°C. Remember to keep warm and avoid catching a cold.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感3℃，早晚温差大，注意及时添衣哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is clear but feels like 3°C. Big temperature swings, dress in layers.
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感5℃，空气湿润，穿暖和些，小心感冒。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels like 5°C. Air is humid, dress warmly to avoid colds.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感7℃，户外活动别忘了多穿一件哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels like 7°C. If you're outdoors, remember to layer up!
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感4℃，户外有些凉，注意保暖防寒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is clear but feels like 4°C. It's a bit chilly outdoors, stay warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感10℃，有点凉意，出门别忘了带外套。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and feels like 10°C. It's a bit cool, remember your jacket!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感-19℃！风力不小，多穿暖和些，别冻着。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -19°C! With strong winds, bundle up warmly.
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感-3℃，户外寒冷，记得全副武装保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast and feels like -3°C. It's cold outdoors, remember to bundle up.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，体感9℃，冬日暖阳，享受舒适的一天。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels like 9°C. Enjoy a comfortable day under the winter sun.
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感12℃，风力稍大，出门注意防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is clear and feels like 12°C with noticeable wind. Mind the wind and stay warm.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感3℃，风力较大，出门务必添衣防风！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is clear but feels like 3°C with strong winds. Dress warmly and mind the wind!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感2℃，注意防寒保暖，别着凉了。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels like 2°C. Remember to keep warm and avoid catching a cold.
